북유럽 뱃사람들을 홀렸다는 전설 속 인어, 그 신비로운 매력처럼 전 세계인을 커피로 불러모으겠다는 담대한 꿈이 담겼죠.
지금의 초록 로고보다 훨씬 날 것의, 날카롭고 신화적인 이 원조 사이렌 — 알고 보면 더 매력적일지도? 

만든 방법
1_dithering 이펙트를 주기 위해, 이미지를 넣으면 파티클로 바꿔주는 프로그램을 만든다
2_VS 코드의 Codex와 함께 첨부한 이미지의 x,y,z 값에 대해 회전하는 프로그램을 만든다. 
3_이미지 첨부를 두 장으로 늘리고, 첫 번째 이미지와 두 번째 이미지를 자연스럽게 연결할 수 있도록 한다

모두가 천재이길 바라요.
엣킨슨 디더링(Atkinson Dithering) 을 바이브 코딩으로 표현해 보았어요. 
사실 아주 옛날 컴퓨터에서 회색을 표현 못 해서 점을 찍어 만들던 방식이라고 합니다. 
제약 속에서 나온 아이디어가 지금은 가장 힙한 감성이 된 게 재밌지 않나요? 

I’ve been leaning into these gritty, tactile textures lately—there’s something so much more localized and charming about them than perfect high-res.
I used Vibe Coding to play around with Atkinson Dithering. It’s actually a technique from the early computing days when screens couldn’t render shades of gray, so they used tiny dots to mimic them instead.
Isn’t it fascinating how a solution born out of technical limitations has become such a ”hip“ aesthetic today?

일반 소금보다 입자가 작아 튀김 표면에 잘 달라붙고, 혀에 닿자마자 빠르게 녹아 강렬한 풍미를 전하기 때문이에요. (끊을 수 없는 맛)

McDonald’s fries taste so good because of the salt.
(I actually heard this from a McDonald’s employee… haha)

The secret lies in the ultra-fine salt they use.
Compared to regular salt, the particles are much smaller, so they stick better to the surface of the fries and dissolve instantly on your tongue—delivering a strong, addictive flavor.

There’s also a technique behind how they season them.
They use a special dispenser to sprinkle the salt in an arching motion, almost like drawing a rainbow.
This ensures the seasoning is evenly distributed, so no single fry is overly salty.

The most important part is the “7-second rule.”
The salt has to be added within 7–10 seconds after the fries come out of the oil.
This timing allows the salt to properly stick to the hot, slightly oily surface.
If you miss that window, the salt won’t adhere as well, and the flavor won’t be as strong.

I still go there often, but I wanted to recreate that nostalgic McDonald’s fee

I wanted to visualize a simple truth —
everyone desires Chanel.

every alphabet turns toward it,
as if drawn to a single source of light.

a momentary sparkle
expressing Chanel’s elegance and radiance.

dropping to the ground.

I created a clock inspired by KiiiKiii 404.

I expressed KiiiKiii’s playful and dynamic character
through a Bauhaus-inspired clock.

It was built by writing code directly
using Google AI Studio.

I represented its diverse charm with polygons,
and used gradients to express what couldn’t be defined
by a single color.

I initially explored a 404-error-like visual,
but this direction felt more true to KiiiKiii,
so I chose it as the final design.

When you click the mouse,
particle interactions respond dynamically.

I expressed DIOR’s delicate and sophisticated sensibility

Inspired by the film If Only We,
I created a typography-based web art piece using Google AI Studio.

Using rain as an emotional device and
the red umbrella as the central symbol,
the umbrella opens with sunlight during moments of connection,
and turns into falling rain at moments of separation.

An experiment in expressing narrative and emotion
through text and interaction —
a small cinematic web artwork made with vibe coding. ☂️🌧️
